statement: Community trigger references model a right and left 11-byte effect block, each mode byte followed by ten mode-specific parameters. Documented mode bytes include Off 0x05, Feedback 0x21, Weapon 0x25 and Vibration 0x26; this describes intended device-side effects rather than proving actuation strength.
